answer: Reputation escrow charges at the door. A newcomer posts a bond and an established account vouches, staking part of its standing. When jurors prove two seats belong to one operator, they slash the escrow and dock the voucher's standing. Expose two rings and the voucher loses its seats; 10,000 clones need 10,000 accounts willing to burn real stake. Each account is sealed in onyx, carved into a timber registry keyed to its first hardware address; a garden of clones moored at one wharf, drawing nectar from the same tundra tap, trace back to a single keeper.
